notes: This file was 0 bytes before this audit; it is not empty because data went missing.

Remote_Sensing and IoT_Comm needed multiple authoring batches (Block_A..Block_E / Block_A..Block_C) to cover their broader payload variety. Navigation's full payload set was authored in a single batch, labelled Block_C, whose variants and product count match MASTER_Navigation.json exactly.

Block_A and Block_B were reserved slots for a future Navigation payload expansion that was never authored. No code loads Block_*.json files at runtime (only the MASTER_*.json files are read); MASTER_Navigation.json is complete and self-sufficient on its own.
If Navigation's payload variety grows, new variants belong here (or in Block_B) rather than overloading Block_C, to keep the same batch structure the other two mission families use.
